name: project-knowledge
description: Rust Core + Rig Agent + TypeScript SDK/MCP 单仓骨架（结构与依赖就绪，功能待实现）

scripts.build:contracts: cargo run -p xtask -- export-contracts && node scripts/generate-types.mjs
scripts.check:contracts: cargo run -p xtask -- export-contracts --check && node scripts/generate-types.mjs --check
scripts.build:mcp: pnpm --filter @project-knowledge/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @project-knowledge/mcp run build
scripts.build:ts: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:mcp
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:sdk && tsc -p packages/sdk --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp --noEmit
